items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: you take the Crescent band, Frankie Duesen and them, Joe Ollivan they used to play.

ctx.x: That was Robichaud, the Superior that was Peter Bocard in there you see, Nile Parade that was the Imperial, and then they had Pierron.

Besides that the rest was, they were playing though, because you take the Crescent band, Frankie Duesen and them, Joe Ollivan they used to play. And people liked their music too because they played nothing but jazz, K-Roy, see? Nothing but jazz. Nothing but jazz. And then you know what I mean? I mean I'm afraid. I'm afraid. I'm afraid. I'm afraid. I'm afraid. But you know I'm afraid. I'm afraid. I'm afraid. I'm afraid. But you know I'm afraid. But dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear dear…
